item.name: Blue Clay Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 6 hours and stores 3,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in blue-flower fields.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Refreshing and Comforting Nectar, plus Blue Extract, Micro-Converters, and Honeysuckle. It adds +25% Blue Pollen and -25% Red Pollen.
item.cost: 10,000,000 Honey, 5 Magic Beans, 15 Blue Extracts, 20 Soft Waxes.
item.cardSummary: Blue Clay Planter grows in about 6 hours and stores 3,000,000 pollen. It favors blue-flower fields and provides blue materials and nectar.

item.name: Candy Planter
item.preferredFields: Strawberry Field, Pineapple Patch, and Coconut Field.
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 4 hours and stores 1,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in Strawberry Field, Pineapple Patch, and Coconut Field.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Motivating Nectar, Gumdrops, and Jelly Beans. It adds +10% White Pollen.
item.cost: 5,000,000 Honey, 5 Magic Beans, 30 Gumdrops, 3 Jelly Beans, 5 Soft Waxes.
item.cardSummary: Candy Planter grows in about 4 hours and stores 1,000,000 pollen. It favors Strawberry Field, Pineapple Patch, and Coconut Field.

item.name: Festive Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 4 hours of playtime and stores 250,000 pollen.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides all five nectar types at x3 and can yield Gingerbread Bears, Eggs, or Night Bells.
item.source: No current direct route is listed.
item.cardSummary: Festive Planter grows in about 4 hours and stores 250,000 pollen. It provides x3 nectar and seasonal rewards.

item.name: Heat-Treated Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 12 hours and stores 25,000,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in red-flower fields.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Invigorating and Motivating Nectar, Red Extracts, and Enzymes. It adds +50% Red Pollen and -50% Blue Pollen.
item.cost: 750B Honey, 75 Magic Beans, 750 Red Extracts, 150 Hard Waxes, 25 Swirled Waxes, 1 Turpentine
item.cardSummary: Heat-Treated Planter grows in about 12 hours and stores 25,000,000,000 pollen. It favors red-flower fields and boosts red pollen.

item.name: Hydroponic Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 12 hours and stores 10,000,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in blue-flower fields.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Refreshing and Comforting Nectar, Blue Extract, and Oil. It adds +50% Blue Pollen and -50% Red Pollen.
item.cost: 750,000,000,000 honey, 75 Magic Beans, 750 Blue Extracts, 500 Soft Waxes, 25 Caustic Waxes, 1 Turpentine
item.cardSummary: Hydroponic Planter grows in about 12 hours and stores 10,000,000,000 pollen. It favors blue-flower fields and boosts blue pollen.

item.name: Paper Planter
item.growthBehavior: A biodegradable planter that grows in about 1 hour and stores 50,000 pollen.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides each nectar type at x0.75.
item.cardSummary: Paper Planter grows in about 1 hour and stores 50,000 pollen. It provides a small amount of each nectar type.

item.name: Pesticide Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 10 hours of playtime and stores 200,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in the 5 Bee Zone.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Satisfying and Motivating Nectar, Bitterberries, and Neonberries. It adds +50% Pollen in the 5 Bee Zone.
item.cost: 750,000,000 Honey, 25 Magic Beans, 25 Neonberries, 15 Glues, 3 Caustic Waxes, 10 Hard Waxes.
item.cardSummary: Pesticide Planter grows in about 10 hours and stores 200,000,000 pollen. It favors the 5 Bee Zone and provides berries.

item.name: Petal Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 14 hours and stores about 100,000,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in white-flower fields.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Comforting and Satisfying Nectar, Jelly Beans, Dice, Glitter, and Star Jelly. It adds +50% White Pollen.
item.cost: 5T Honey, 100 Magic Beans, 100 Glitters, 250 Soft Waxes, 50 Swirled Waxes, 25 Super Smoothies.
item.cardSummary: Petal Planter grows in about 14 hours and stores about 100,000,000,000 pollen. It favors white-flower fields and boosts white pollen.

item.name: Plastic Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 2 hours and stores 250,000 pollen.
item.cardSummary: Plastic Planter grows in about 2 hours and stores 250,000 pollen.

item.name: Red Clay Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 6 hours and stores 3,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in red-flower fields.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Invigorating and Satisfying Nectar, Red Extract, and Waxes. It adds +50% Red Pollen and -50% Blue Pollen.
item.cost: 10,000,000 Honey, 5 Magic Beans, 15 Red Extract, 20 Soft Waxes.
item.cardSummary: Red Clay Planter grows in about 6 hours and stores 3,000,000 pollen. It favors red-flower fields and provides red materials.

item.name: Sticker Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 3 hours of playtime and stores 200,000 pollen.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides all five nectar types at x2, plus Stickers, and spawns a rare-or-better Puffshroom.
item.cardSummary: Sticker Planter grows in about 3 hours and stores 200,000 pollen. It provides Stickers and spawns a rare-or-better Puffshroom.

item.name: Tacky Planter
item.preferredFields: The Starting Zone and fields near the hives.
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 8 hours and stores 15,000,000 pollen. It grows faster in the Starting Zone and near the hives.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides Satisfying and Comforting Nectar, Field Dice, and Sunflower Seeds. It adds +100% Pollen in the Starting Zone.
item.cost: 50,000,000 Honey, 10 Magic Beans, 1 Purple Potion, 5 Hard Waxes, and 20 Soft Waxes.
item.cardSummary: Tacky Planter grows in about 8 hours and stores 15,000,000 pollen. It favors the Starting Zone and supports satisfying and comforting nectar.

item.name: The Planter Of Plenty
item.preferredFields: Pepper Patch, Stump Field, Coconut Field, and Mountain Top Field.
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 16 hours and stores 1 trillion pollen. It grows faster in Pepper Patch, Stump Field, Coconut Field, and Mountain Top Field.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides all five nectar types at +50%, plus Neonberries, Waxes, and Turpentine. It adds +33% Pollen in Mountain Top Field.
item.cost: 100T Honey, 500 Magic Beans, 100 Super Smoothies, 100 Swirled Waxes, 100 Caustic Waxes, 25 Turpentine.
item.cardSummary: The Planter Of Plenty grows in about 16 hours and stores 1 trillion pollen. It favors four late fields and provides rare materials.

item.name: Ticket Planter
item.growthBehavior: Grows in about 2 hours of playtime and stores 50,000 pollen.
item.nectarOrDrops: Provides all five nectar types at x2, plus Tickets, and spawns a Puffshroom.
item.source: Dapper Bear can give three Ticket Planters on the first conversation.
item.cardSummary: Ticket Planter grows in about 2 hours and stores 50,000 pollen. It provides Tickets and spawns a Puffshroom.
